SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Mombasa
   C. Nairobi
   D. Kisumu

2. Which statement about Weather and Climate is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Weather and Climate never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Weather and Climate.
   C. Explain Weather and Climate with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Weather and Climate as rumours only.

3. Which statement about Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage as rumours only.
   B. Explain Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage.
   D. Say Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage never happens in Kenya.

4. Which statement about Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya Sites Sceneries is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya Sites Sceneries with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya Sites Sceneries as rumours only.
   C. Say Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya Sites Sceneries never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya Sites Sceneries.

5. Which statement about Fishing in Kenya Victoria Turkana Naivasha Tana and River Athi is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Fishing in Kenya Victoria Turkana Naivasha Tana and River Athi never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Fishing in Kenya Victoria Turkana Naivasha Tana and River Athi.
   C. Explain Fishing in Kenya Victoria Turkana Naivasha Tana and River Athi with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Fishing in Kenya Victoria Turkana Naivasha Tana and River Athi as rumours only.

6. Which statement about Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites as rumours only.
   C. Say Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites.

7. Which statement about Development of Transport is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Development of Transport never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Development of Transport as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Development of Transport.
   D. Explain Development of Transport with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Which statement about School administration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat School administration as rumours only.
   B. Say School administration never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing School administration.
   D. Explain School administration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Replace the compass rose

10. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Ignore prices in shops

11. Which statement about Population distribution in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Population distribution in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Population distribution in Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Population distribution in Kenya.
   D. Treat Population distribution in Kenya as rumours only.

12. Which statement about The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui.

   D. Say The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui never happens in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Early forms of Governm ent in Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Citizenship in Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Location, Position and Size of Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
